rules.title: 33rd ANNUAL QUEENS TOURNAMENT RULES
items: This is an individual scratch tournament open to all current USBC female members.
The 2027 City Queens champion will receive money, a trophy, and an entry into the 2028 WSUBC Queens Tournament.
Entry fee shall be $100. $20 for lineage. $80 for the prize fund. Entries will close 30 minutes prior to start time of tournament.
Check-In time will be at 8 a.m.
Tournament will begin on February 7, 2027 at 9:00a.m. Lane assignments will be given at check-in.
You will bowl 8 games of qualifying. Moving after every game.
1 in 4 will make the first cut---and cash.
You will then have Round Robin Match Play.
We will then cut to the top 3 for Stepladder Finals.

If a tie exists, a 9th & 10th frame roll-off shall immediately be held. Failure of any contestant to remain available in case of a tie will constitute a forfeit. A 9th and 10th frame will be rolled until the tie is broken.

Youth bowlers, who have not attained the age of 18, must furnish written authorization signed by a parent or guardian. Written authorization must be filed with the entry form unless her parent or guardian will accompany the student to check in, where consent form may be filed.
We will issue a check to the Smart Account for any female youth bowler that cashes.
All other USBC rules will apply.
Prize fund will be returned 100 percent.
Tournament Director makes the final decisions on all disputes.
